newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWB rejects all bids in fifth wheat tender.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWB rejects all bids in fifth wheat tender.

text.p: The Australian Wheat Board (AWB) again rejected all offers and sold no wheat from its pools in its fifth domestic tender held today.
Bids were submitted for 30,000 tonnes of new crop wheat in five port zones, AWB said.
All bids were either at or below current estimates of pool equity and growers were reluctant to sell at these prices, it said.
Successful tenders would need to show some premium, it said.

Closing date for the next tender is September 11.
NOTE - ASW: Australian Standard White; APW: Australian Premium White; AH: Australian Hard; APH: Australian Prime Hard; SHAR is a high protein hard Victorian wheat.
